All Kotlin declarations generated by the cinterop tool from Objective-C libraries should have the @ExperimentalForeignApi annotation. Native platform libraries shipped with Kotlin/Native (like Foundation, UIKit, and POSIX) require opt-in only for some APIs. Kotlin/Native provides indirect interoperability with Swift through Objective-C. This document covers how you can use Kotlin declarations in Swift/Objective-C code and Objective-C declarations in Kotlin code. Some other resources you might find useful: The Kotlin-Swift interopedia , a collection of examples on how to use Kotlin declarations in Swift code.
